description: We are from Yayasan Sarawak International Secondary School Kuching.
summary:
We created a website where anyone can access our findings on potential natural space analogs found on our beloved planet, Earth. The website features an interactive globe that allows users to explore different discovered locations, learn about why these places serve as suitable space analogs, and participate in interactive games and quizzes available on the website.

Through this website, we aim to make information about natural space analogs more accessible and engaging to the public. By combining an interactive globe with educational content, games, and quizzes, users can explore different locations and understand how environments on Earth can simulate conditions found in outer space. This creates an enjoyable and interactive learning experience that makes complex astronomical concepts easier to understand.

This project is important because it helps expand public knowledge and understanding of natural space analogs and their significance in space exploration. It also serves as an educational platform to raise awareness about advancements in astronomy and space research. By making scientific information accessible and engaging, we hope to inspire curiosity, encourage learning, and develop greater public interest in space exploration.
details: We have created a website that displays lesser-known and newly discovered space analogs through various interactive elements, such as globes of Earth, Mars, and the Moon, as well as a space analog simulator. It does this by identifying the location on the lunar or Martian surface that the user wants to simulate. Then, it pinpoints every space analog on Earth that mimics those surface conditions. We created this website in the hope that it can improve future space missions by providing scientists with information on space analogs that are comparable or better than existing ones. We also hope that the game we've provided allows young space enthusiasts to deepen their love for astronomy.
